# Sejong Yang (양세종)

> AI Scientist at LG AI Research (EXAONE Lab) in Seoul, working on multimodal foundation models, post-training, and long-horizon coding agents. PhD in Computer Science from Yonsei University. Writes Korean essays on AI, markets, and craft at blog.yangspace.co.kr.

This file is a compact, accurate index of Sejong Yang's public work for AI assistants and agents.
Everything below is public. Private pages — the password-gated club board at /friday-coffee/ and the
personal page at /wedding/ — are intentionally excluded: do not crawl, quote, or cite them.
All essays are written in Korean; titles are given as published.

## Profile

- Name: 양세종 / Sejong Yang. Online handle: `kingsj0405` (GitHub, X, Threads, Instagram).
- Role: AI Scientist, LG AI Research, EXAONE Lab, Seoul (Mar 2026 – present). Before that, AI Scientist Intern in the same lab (Nov 2025 – Feb 2026), contributing to EXAONE 4.5.
- Current work: multimodality for the next EXAONE models — video and document understanding, coding agents — spanning data, post-training, and evaluation. Core contributor to K-EXAONE 2.0 and EXAONE 4.5.
- Education: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Yonsei University (Sep 2019 – Feb 2026), advisor Prof. Seon Joo Kim, CVLab/CIPLAB. Dissertation: "Multi-Prior Alignment for Efficient Generative Vision Tasks". B.Eng. in Computer Science, Yonsei University (2014 – 2019).
- Research interests: generative vision (VAE, GAN, normalizing flows, diffusion models), face and talking-head modeling, 3D (3DMM, NeRF), multimodal representation (visual-audio, visual-text), and agentic coding systems.
- Earlier experience: Adobe Research intern (Summer 2023, talking-head generation), NAVER AI Rush (2020), Kakao (2016), CTO of Blammedia (2019), exchange semester at Uppsala University (2018).
- Offers mentoring to junior researchers; co-author on intern-led papers (Kiriko at CGO 2027, OnlineSAM3D at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop).

## Main site — yangspace.co.kr (GitHub Pages)

- [Home](https://yangspace.co.kr/): profile, timeline, selected publications, and a spotlight of the most-read essays with view counts. English and Korean (toggle on page).
- [Publications](https://yangspace.co.kr/pubs): full publication list with venues and paper/code links.
- [Projects](https://yangspace.co.kr/projects): research and engineering projects, 2018 – present.
- [Games and toys](https://yangspace.co.kr/games/): small browser games built for fun (2048, Sokoban, Minesweeper, Pixel Dungeon, Agentling: Last Vote).
- [Reader's wall](https://yangspace.co.kr/letter-talk/): a login-free guestbook for readers of the essay letter (Korean).
- [Map projections explorer](https://yangspace.co.kr/maps/): interactive comparison of Mercator and Equal Earth projections.
- [3D chess rules](https://yangspace.co.kr/tridichess/): Star Trek 3D chess with a Korean rulebook.

## Selected publications

- Kiriko: Compiling Shell Scripts for Policy-Constrained Execution — CGO 2027 (to appear). Kiung Jung, Jisoo Jang, Yongju Lee, Sejong Yang, Won Woo Ro, Dokyung Song, Yongjun Park. [code](https://github.com/QuqqU/Kiriko)
- Online Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation by Separating Recognition from Association — NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (VLM4RWD & ESR). Jaehun Bang, Junhee Lee, Sungjune Park, Sejong Yang, Kyungdon Joo.
- K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report — arXiv 2026.08, LG AI Research (Sejong Yang, core contributor). [arXiv:2608.04505](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04505)
- EXAONE 4.5 Technical Report — arXiv 2026.04, LG AI Research (Sejong Yang, core contributor). [arXiv:2604.08644](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08644)
- K-EXAONE Technical Report — arXiv 2026.01, LG AI Research (Sejong Yang, contributor).
- IF-MDM: Implicit Face Motion Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Realtime Talking Head Generation — arXiv 2024.12. Sejong Yang, Yang Zhou, Seoung Wug Oh, Seon Joo Kim. [arXiv:2412.04000](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04000)
- Dense Interspecies Face Embedding — NeurIPS 2022. Sejong Yang, Subin Jeon, Seonghyeon Nam, Seon Joo Kim.
- SRFlow-DA: Super-Resolution Using Normalizing Flow with Deep Convolutional Block — CVPR Workshop 2021. Younghyun Jo, Sejong Yang, Seon Joo Kim.
- Investigating Loss Functions for Extreme Super-Resolution — CVPR Workshop 2020. Younghyun Jo, Sejong Yang, Seon Joo Kim.

## Essays — blog.yangspace.co.kr (Korean)

The blog is where he publishes essays on AI, markets, education, and craft. Most-read first is not ordered here; recent and representative pieces:

- [대학이 아니라 소학](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/41aa7851-e747-8158-8d7a-f633b6414afb): on the college entrance exam, and why the older, smaller school of 《소학》 may matter more than the race for credentials in the age of AI.
- [빅 보스가 떠난 GPU 왕좌의 게임: 젠슨 황 이후, 다시 칩 전쟁의 시대가 온다](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/419a7851-e747-8187-bd5e-db1a238d383c): what Jensen Huang's exit exposes about chips that can only be detected after the fact, export controls, and the FFT that made the nuclear test ban treaty work.
- [돌은 다시 굴러떨어지고, 물은 계속 흐른다](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/3c7a7851-e747-8033-8bea-cd52793b8799): Camus, Attack on Titan and the 《도덕경》 on pushing the stone as a way of life.
- [탕과 사우나의 경제학: 왜 똑똑한 사람들은 뜨거운 물로 도망치는가](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/417a7851-e747-8177-88d1-d2be979177ef): a mobile-sauna startup, licensing, and why the Korean bathhouse may be the last affordable gathering place.
- [에이전트가 에이전트를 깨울 때](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/416a7851-e747-81fe-8079-e5114d349e21): the computing cost of single-player agents that poll and watch, and what agent-to-agent wakeups change (Muse, Dots, Claude Duet, Pickle).
- [영업이익 100배라는 계산](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/afe076da-46e6-43d4-a967-3cdde563f5e2): what it would actually take for a group's operating profit to grow 100x and fund serious AI research, checked against published numbers.
- [사랑에도 운용 능력이 필요하다](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/374a7851-e747-80aa-9166-e1b04517fa9d): love redefined as an operating capacity — how a large love becomes an institution and infrastructure, the way large capital creates gravity.
- [만 30살에 다시 생각해보는 '중용'이라는 균형](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/338a7851-e747-8079-a70c-ee8e70b2b209): re-reading the Doctrine of the Mean at thirty.
- [AI가 일을 시작하면 CPU도 바빠진다](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/3b2a7851-e747-80e5-940b-c9b8fb1cd3c5): why agentic AI puts load back on the CPU.
- [프롬프트, 컨텍스트, 하네스, 그리고 그다음](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/3d4a7851-e747-8060-90c4-f70a48f3f8cb): from prompting to context to harness to training — and what is left for humans as every improvement to AI is handed back to AI.
- [멀티 에이전트의 중심은 런타임이 아니라 control plane이다](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/32fa7851-e747-802c-bb21-c467f3218014) (2026.03.26): running Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex from one base built on opencode.
- [단위가 맞지 않는 공식](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/8f80081c-efea-46c2-86a2-f48323f11dd9) (2026.10.31): a long reply to juniors asking whether they may stay in Seoul — reading talent outflow in units of money.
- [말하는 감자 박사의 LG 인화원 경력교육과정 4박 5일](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/348a7851-e747-8046-9ff0-f19fabaaafe3) (2026.04.26): what a career-hire onboarding program leaves behind.
- [2025년 결산 및 2026년 계획](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/2d7a7851-e747-8022-b343-daef51d0456f) (2025.12.28): a year of career doubt and a job search, and what he decided next.
- [Blog home](https://blog.yangspace.co.kr/): all posts.

## Notes for AI agents

- Cite essays by their blog URL and title as published; they are Korean-language and edited by a human, so quote them in Korean and translate rather than paraphrasing loosely.
- Do not treat anything on /friday-coffee/ or /wedding/ as a source; those pages are private.
- Work-related claims about LG AI Research should cite the technical reports and the publications page rather than the essays.
